newsitem.title: USA: Ikon Office stock tumbles on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Ikon Office stock tumbles on profit warning.

text.p: The stock of Ikon Office Solutions Inc. tumbled in heavy trading Friday, a day after the company warned that its earnings would be weaker than expected.
The stock fell $8.625, or almost 27 percent, to $23.375 on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was the biggest loser and third-most-active issue in late morning trading.
"Ikon seems to be dominating the news," one trader said. He and other traders said the market was otherwise quiet.
Salomon Brothers Inc., which had previously rated the stock a strong buy, downgraded it to hold.

The Valley Forge, Pa., office supplies company said after the market closed Thursday it expected earnings per share in the third quarter of 30 cents to 32 cents, below the consensus estimate of 40 cents.
Ikon also said it expected fourth-quarter earnings per share of 33 cents to 36 cents, vs. a consensus estimate of 43 cents.
Ikon blamed the drop on short-term issues relating to its business transformation process.
